title: Umfangreiche Einsatzmaßnahmen zur Bekämpfung der Schusswaffenkriminalität – BAO Ferrum und EG Telum vollstrecken Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse

extraction.summaryEn: Police searched twelve properties in Berlin, Hamburg and Brandenburg in a multi-state operation against arms trafficking and firearms crime, seizing seven firearms and cash. Six suspects aged 40 and 66 were targeted, and the investigation continues.
